keyFindings.description: A session:<id> mention whose lookup goes unanswered within 250 ms adds nothing to mentionedSessions, so suppressed_authors omits that session: a reply in a thread a session rooted, or a new comment on a document a session wrote, reaches it twice (author route dispatch-<event id> and the mention <comment>:<target>:<mode>). Base resolved inside the client's 5 s window and suppressed it. The test at comment_delivery_sender_test.go:377-380 pins the duplicate.

Once the Lifetime ends, queueLocked refuses every send silently (comments committing during the HTTP drain, sends still queued). Only a process that starts later recovers them; under the gcp:Dispatch RollingUpdate for replicas > 1 (maxSurge 1, maxUnavailable 0) the successor starts first and runs its one pass before the old pod's SIGTERM, so those attempts stay pending for good. Production runs replicas 1 (Recreate) today; the component supports more.
